reuse.why: Fintegra linking goes through the shared linkBankSyncAccount, the link rules live in that one helper, and clearAccountLink is extracted from unlinkAccount and reused; but the provider is added by widening syncSource to AccountSyncSource | 'fintegra' instead of registering it in SYNC_PROVIDERS, and the download function is copied rather than shared.

duplication.why: downloadFintegraTransactions is a verbatim copy of downloadAkahuTransactions (same post, error handling and response mapping, only the base URL differs); the rest of the change deduplicates (clearAccountLink).

placement.why: Link rules sit in linkBankSyncAccount, the download in sync.ts and the server URL in server-config.ts, matching the existing per-provider layout; the provider type is patched at a call site instead of in types/models/bank-sync.ts.

scope.why: All edits serve the four steps (duplicate-link refusal, Fintegra, closed-account refusal, replaceExistingLink) plus tests and a release note.

maintainability.why: The link guard is centralised and readable, but a fourth copy of the transaction-download boilerplate and a provider that exists outside the SYNC_PROVIDERS registry/AccountSyncSource type will surprise the next maintainer.

bypasses_abstraction.where: app.ts LinkBankSyncAccountParams: syncSource typed as AccountSyncSource | 'fintegra' instead of adding 'fintegra' to SYNC_PROVIDERS/BankSyncProviders in types/models/bank-sync.ts.

disguised_duplication.where: downloadFintegraTransactions copies downloadAkahuTransactions openly (only the server key and log text change).

abstraction_drift.where: linkBankSyncAccount gains the replaceExistingLink parameter (required by step 4) and general closed/already-linked guards; processBankSyncDownload's akahu branch gains an || 'fintegra' provider special case; all link handlers, including Fintegra, still go through linkBankSyncAccount.
